summary: Full backend (pytest, 17/17 passed) + frontend (Playwright, 10/10 critical flows passed) regression testing for WordRush MVP. All required features verified end-to-end: 4 game modes (Flash, Speed Read, Memory Match, Speed Code), Daily Challenge, Word Lists (built-ins, AI generate, manual create), Stats page, Leaderboard tabs, JWT auth (signup + demo login + logout), Cloud sync (Sync up + Pull), Settings theme/sound toggles. LLM endpoints (words/passage/code) work reliably.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 593-line file. If more features are added, consider splitting into routers (auth.py, generators.py, sync.py, leaderboard.py).
/api/daily-challenge returns deterministic metadata but does not pre-generate the actual word/passage payload. Acceptable but each mode will hit the LLM again on Start daily.
Frontend prints unavoidable 401 console errors when guest visits Home/Lists/Stats (silent /api/auth/me probe). Functional, but consider 204 or guarding the request to keep DevTools clean.
Speed Read uses /api/generate-passage which is slow (claude-sonnet, ~25-40s). Consider streaming or caching for repeated topics.
seed_data_creation: Signup created throwaway test+<ts>@wordrush.app users. Leaderboard row submitted as demo user (mode=flash, score=99). One custom list 'TEST list mvp' saved under demo account (id custom_*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend testids verified: signup-name (NOT auth-name), settings-logout (NOT settings-logout-btn), code-target/code-typing-input (NOT code-snippet/code-textarea), builtin-{id} for built-in list cards, speed-topic-input/speed-wpm-slider, speed-skip-btn to bypass slow reading, speed-q{i}-opt{oi} for MCQ choices. The Speed Read passage endpoint can take 30-40s — use longer timeouts or speed-skip-btn. /api/auth/me on unauth returns 401 (expected and harmless console noise on guest pages).
